capabilities: collect a note and all recursively linked notes
pack collected notes and binary files into a ZIP
prompt a save dialog for the ZIP location
configure exclusion rules by frontmatter, headers, folders, and file patterns
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to share or back up one note together with the notes and files it links to.
summary: Export plugin that bundles a note and all recursively linked notes and binary attachments into a single ZIP file.
